drills.name: Independent kill switch
drills.objective: Disabling writes removes the capability from the model and refuses it if requested anyway, without stopping reads, and is reversible

drills.name: Corpus rollback
drills.objective: A bad corpus version can be rolled back and the change is attributable

drills.name: Safe degraded mode
drills.objective: Losing the model refuses explicitly, fabricates nothing, and leaves retrieval up

drills.name: Restart recovery
drills.objective: Approvals, corpus activation, and containment survive a process restart

drills.name: Backup and restore
drills.objective: A corrupted database is detected and a backup restores state with an intact chain
drills.scope: SQLite file backup only; not PostgreSQL PITR (NS-EXC-004)

summary.scope: Single-node local simulation. These drills exercise the kill switch, corpus rollback, degraded mode, restart recovery, and SQLite file backup and restore. They do not exercise the PostgreSQL failover, point-in-time recovery, audit custody separation, or outbox reconciliation specified in docs/operations/persistence-recovery-exercises.md, which remain unexecuted.
